title: Underground Field
hintPlace: Select a block and click an empty adjacent tile to place one
conveyorHint: Conveyor placement: click an empty tile to place
distributeHint: Distribute ON: click a conveyor to load the selected item
brandSubtitle: Dig deeper into a world of stone
inventoryNote: In placement mode, choose a block here and place it in the field.
quickNote: Use the arrow buttons to switch resource pages.
howto1: Mine one block at a time when it touches an air tile.
howto2: Mining ON collects the clicked block.
howto3: Mining OFF places one selected block at a time.
howto4: Dig deeper to discover new resource layers.
